mechanism: Tramadol is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; berberine inhibits CYP3A4 and may inhibit CYP2D6, potentially increasing tramadol levels and serotonin syndrome risk, while berberine also has independent CNS effects.
action: Monitor patients for increased tramadol adverse effects (dizziness, drowsiness, serotonin syndrome symptoms) and consider tramadol dose reduction if co-administered; counsel on additive CNS depression risk.
